reviews.text: I used grocery for 4 years and this year the app has stopped working. It won’t open at all and now I can’t access my recipes. I’ll update this review when the bug is fixed.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: This app needs MUCH more attention. The creators behind this app are clearly not actually using this app. It’s such a mess honestly. I thought it would be as simple as Notes, just make a list. All I wanted was to be able to add prices, then get a total. I thought this app would do just that. But no, it’s beyond confusing. “What’s in stock/out of stock” that feature makes no sense. I just want to go thro a mastery list & add what I need for the day. If you don’t need something on your list, you can select it but it doesn’t go awhile, so you still see while shopping. Or you have to remove it from the list & then whatever the inventory feature does with it, is confusing. I don’t need a damn inventory keeping track, it has no idea what I’ve used through the week or not. It’s assuming. I could go on, but I’ll stop here. Someone needs to actually use this app not just create it & put it out there for others to figure out what’s wrong with it. Don’t waste your time with this app.

reviews.title: Use to be great, only ok now
reviews.text: I really only use this app for event meal planning on shopping. What loved about it was I would tell it what recipes I want to cook, check off things I already have, and it would make one clean list. I had smart Clean Up on and I am still getting 6 different “egg” list items. I try to rename them with count to see if then it would combine and instead the item just vanished. I am using it for one more event as I am too close to the food shopping to find a new one but I will be changing soon.

reviews.title: A bit buggy!
reviews.text:
Update: app no longer opens, dev needs to give it a bit of tlc

Pros: this app integrates really well with ios reminders, meaning it also works with Siri. It also has a decent Apple Watch app, works with live activities, and is very customisable. 

Cons: quite a few bugs! I’ve noticed things like ui elements duplicating, graphical flashing, and the settings menu doesn’t always save my changes forcing me to redo them. Also, let’s be honest, the app is a little bit ugly. 

Suggestions: fix the bugs, obviously. I’d also really like to see a beautification pass. Some translucency layers and some textured/skeuomorphic backgrounds could go a long way, maybe even different backgrounds per list. Please look at the Wishlists app for inspiration. I’d also like to see the recipes section get a glow up, at a minimum I’d like to be able to add images. Please look at the Mela app for inspiration. Lastly, I really like the geofencing idea, but as someone who really likes to have just one shopping list, I’d like to have the ability to add multiple geofences to one list.

reviews.title: Randomly Deleting Lists
reviews.text: Spent an hour making my grocery list and when I opened it at the store it had deleted my whole list

reviews.title: Has some good points but
reviews.text:
It’s just far too complicated to use. The nonsense with sorting is totally needless and who knows what it’s trying to do.

Household sync doesn’t work at all on our phones and the explanations in help are long-winded and confusion. I really don’t care, I just want to share lists.

It should just work and it doesn’t.

On a single phone and ignoring the over-bloated sorting, it’s fine but there are hundreds of list apps that work for that purpose.
